newsitem.title: UK: UK's Merchant Retail Christmas sales rise.
newsitem.headline: UK's Merchant Retail Christmas sales rise.

text.p: Britain's Merchant Retail Group Plc said on Wednesday its like-for-like sales rose by nine percent in the nine weeks to January 4 compared to the year-ago period.
Overall sales rose 17.1 percent in the period, the company said in a statement.
"The crucial Christmas trading period has proved to be satisfactory for the group, with sales ahead of budget and an excellent result from The Perfume Shop," the company said.
Its Perfume Shop chain had an 18.6 percent increase in like-for-like sales during the period.
With 32 stores now trading, compared to 26 at Christmas 1995, overall sales at the chain rose by 37.2 percent, the company said in a statement.
"This performance has further endorsed the group's confidence in the business, and up to 15 new branches are being sought for 1997," the company said.
Like-for-like sales at the company's Joplings department store division rose 3.3 percent.
